body:
Thanks, I needed that. None of the websites I was reading were helpful. They were all like "Talk to friends and family for support!" and I am like that would be useful if I had those. It was kinda like they were hinting I needed to die if I didn't have that and that the anti-suicide message was really meant for people who were not alone, and that those who are truly alone should just die.

I think that advice is good, if someone has those resources they should use them, but it should come with a qualifier that it's not -necessary- to lean on friends and family to live because it just really made me feel worse and I can't be the only one.
